pcs.pc_description: conduct regular inspections of airside areas including runways, taxiways, aprons, signage, lighting, and markings
identify foreign object debris (FOD), surface damage, and other hazards that could affect aircraft and vehicular safety
ensure all safety equipment and markings are present, functional, and compliant with regulatory standards
verify that airside construction or maintenance works are cordoned off and compliant with safety protocols
ensure safety procedures are followed by all personnel and vehicles operating in airside areas
accurately document inspection findings in accordance with organizational protocols
report hazards or breaches in safety protocols to relevant authorities promptly.
follow up on reported issues to ensure timely rectification and closure.
participate in safety meetings and briefings, and share updates related to airside safety.
support emergency response procedures in case of safety-related incidents.

pcs.pc_description: Comprehend the purpose and importance of SMS in aviation.
Understand the four components of an SMS: Safety Policy, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion.
Identify the regulatory requirements related to SMS (e.g., ICAO, DGCA).
Recognize the roles and responsibilities of personnel in maintaining SMS.
Understand the integration of SMS with organizational functions.
Assist in developing safety policies and objectives.
Participate in hazard identification and risk assessment activities.
Help establish safety reporting systems and encourage safety reporting culture.
Monitor safety performance indicators.
Maintain documentation and records related to SMS implementation.
Support internal safety audits and inspections.
Identify areas for improvement in SMS processes.
Participate in safety training and communication initiatives.
Assist in updating SMS procedures in response to operational changes or audit findings.
Contribute to fostering a positive safety culture.

pcs.pc_description: Understand types of risks in aviation operations (safety, operational, financial, legal).
Identify potential hazards using systematic methods.
Conduct risk assessments and evaluate consequences and likelihood.
Implement appropriate risk control measures.
Monitor and review the effectiveness of risk mitigation actions.
Document and report risk-related findings in compliance with organizational procedures.
Understand the objectives and scope of aviation compliance audits.
Prepare audit checklists and plans based on relevant regulations and internal policies.
Conduct compliance audits in an organized and impartial manner.
Collect and verify audit evidence through observations, interviews, and document review.
Identify non-conformities and assess their impact on operations.
Prepare audit reports with findings, root causes, and recommendations.
Support the development of corrective and preventive action plans (CAPA).
Monitor implementation of corrective actions and validate closure.
Contribute to organizational learning and continuous improvement through audit feedback.
